dimension_description: Moment of inertia measures resistance to angular acceleration. It depends not just on mass but on how far that mass sits from the axis, which is why a bicycle wheel, a door, and the Earth can all appear here meaningfully. Values are always axis-specific, so the item label matters a lot.
